author: MIT OpenCourseWare
description:
Khan Academy founder Sal Khan discusses the significance of democratizing knowledge, his initial reaction to the announcement of MIT OpenCourseWare, and its connection to Khan Academy in this extended footage of his interview from the documentary “The Courage to Be Open: MIT OpenCourseWare and the Democratization of Knowledge.”

View the full documentary here ᐅ https://youtu.be/RkhSkE89KJ0?si=VHiS_uuD7DJ1pyF4

This documentary is the second of MIT Open Learning's MIT Stories documentary series. View all MIT Stories here ᐅ https://learn.mit.edu/video-playlist/88445/mit-stories

Please note that the content of this video, and the MIT Stories documentaries, is not covered under OCW's Creative Commons license.
title: Sal Khan discusses MIT OpenCourseWare
